pages.text: The $(2)Zephyr Controller$() is the brain of your shipping empire. Without it, your haulers have no idea where to deliver their cargo. It acts as a portable remote and address book for all your stations.
Crafting the controller requires refined iron ingots, redstone components, and specialized structural parts.

pages.title: Registering a Dock
pages.text: To save a destination, approach any placed Zephyr Dock and perform a $(2)Shift + Click$() with the Controller in hand. The device will store the dock's exact name, dimensions, and coordinates.

pages.title: Registering a Dock
pages.text: When successfully linked, a confirmation message will pop up in your chat indicating the dock has been added to the controller's memory.

pages.title: Selecting Destinations
pages.text: Right-click the air while holding the Controller to open its management GUI. Here you can review all saved docks, check their current status, and select your active target.

pages.title: Linking the Hauler
pages.text: Once your destination is selected in the controller, perform a $(2)Shift + Right-Click$() with your Zephyr Hauler onto the target chest or machine to bind them together and launch!

pages.title: Dual Management
pages.text: The Controller features two tabs: $(2)Docks$() for individual landing pads, and $(2)Hubs$() for entire networks.$(br)$(br)When viewing a Hub, you will see a telemetry bracket like $(2)[ 6 | 1 | 0 | 0 ]$(), representing the exact amount of Free, Reserved, Occupied, and Inaccessible docks in that network.
